_meta.note: The real proposal, not a hypothetical. Where a field is inferred rather than documented, _confidence says so.
_meta.status: Ordinance O-25-73 has NOT been confirmed passed. First reading 2025-12-04 passed 5-1-1. A federal judge ordered several related ordinances redone in July 2026 over open-meeting violations; the rezoning was re-passed as emergency legislation in Sept 2026 but the CRA agreement was not part of that push. Hold at proposed terms.

site._confidence: high — Clinton County Auditor parcel layer

facility._mw_confidence: medium — from PJM transmission need Dayton-2025-002, which describes a customer request near Clinton Substation but NEVER NAMES THE CUSTOMER. The AWS link is strong inference, not documentation. An independent capex-based estimate gave 300-530 MW, which corroborates.
facility._cooling_confidence: low — the Port Authority claims 97% outside-air cooling and ~6 MG/year of water, which is 25-40x below LBNL norms. This is a developer claim from a party to the project, and it is the single biggest sensitivity in the model.

policy._confidence: medium — terms are from the first reading and the Port Authority FAQ. The school board approved its compensation agreement 2025-11-19. Final council passage unconfirmed.

grid._note: Under the proposed tariff the customer pays network upgrade costs in full. If the tariff is rejected or weakened, those costs socialise. This is the main ratepayer lever.

levers._note: Ranges the UI sweeps. Defaults above are the as-proposed values.
